_doc: model picks the body; add ?model=drone to the URL to try another one. Models map to sprites in tools/sprites/.
_regenDoc: After delayMs without being hit, 1 hp returns every everyMs.
_dashDoc: Dash: Shift/K/X, right mouse button, gamepad B/L1, or swipe on the right half of a touch screen. Invulnerable while dashing.
_featureDoc: feature = default visor [dark, light]; featureColors = choices offered for profiles and drift (Endesga 32 indexes).
